name: reels-intelligence-hub
description: AI-powered Instagram research and knowledge platform built on Cloudflare.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @rih/web && npm run build --workspace @rih/api
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npm run typecheck --workspace @rih/api && wrangler deploy --config apps/api/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build:web && npm run typecheck --workspace @rih/api && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir apps/api/dist --config apps/api/wrangler.toml
